name: straight-arm-pushdown-cable
title: Straight Arm Pushdown: Cable
primer: This exercise is for strengthening the Lats and also works the Triceps.
steps: Grasp a wide pull down bar with a wide grip so your hands are on the portion of the bar which curves down.
Stand erect with your abs drawn in.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows and your wrists steady pull the bar down from the starting position to your upper thighs.
With a controlled motion bring the bar back up to the starting position.
